svg.title: What a leaderboard row contains, using the DeepSeek entry on Terminal-bench 4.1
svg.desc: Four columns labelled model, agent, settings and score. The example row reads DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at max, run under Claude Code, on Terminal-bench 4.1 default table sorted by resolution rate, scoring 38.5 percent plus or minus 3.8 with 8.2 billion tokens. A footer notes that CommandCode and OpenCode do not appear as agents on the board.
svg.text: A leaderboard row is four fields, not one number
Terminal-bench 4.1, read 23 November 2026. The example is the only row naming DeepSeek's current model.
Neither product being compared appears in the agent column.

g.text: CommandCode: not listed as an agent on either board
OpenCode: not listed as an agent on either board

svg.text: Sources: swebench.com and tbench.ai, read 23 November 2026. Agent and settings decide which number the score belongs to.
